verses.original: Ὁ πρεσβύτερος Γαΐῳ τῷ ἀγαπητῷ ὃν ἐγὼ ἀγαπῶ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: Ho presbyteros Gaiō tō agapētō hon egō agapō en alētheia
verses.literal: The elder To the beloved Gaius whom I love in the truth

verses.original: Ἀγαπητέ περὶ πάντων εὔχομαί σε εὐοδοῦσθαι καὶ ὑγιαίνειν καθὼς εὐοδοῦταί σου ἡ ψυχή
verses.transliteration: Agapēte peri pantōn euchomai se euodousthai kai hygiainein kathōs euodoutai sou hē psychē
verses.literal: Beloved I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health as your soul also prospers

verses.original: ἐχάρην γὰρ λίαν ἐρχομένων ἀδελφῶν καὶ μαρτυρούντων σου τῇ ἀληθείᾳ καθὼς σὺ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ περιπατεῖς
verses.transliteration: echarēn gar lian erchomenōn adelphōn kai martyrountōn sou tē alētheia kathōs sy en alētheia peripateis
verses.literal: For I was overjoyed . . . when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth in which . . . you continue to walk

verses.original: μειζοτέραν τούτων οὐκ ἔχω χαράν ἵνα ἀκούω τὰ ἐμὰ τέκνα ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ περιπατοῦντα
verses.transliteration: meizoteran toutōn ouk echō charan hina akouō ta ema tekna en tē alētheia peripatounta
verses.literal: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth

verses.original: Ἀγαπητέ πιστὸν ποιεῖς ὃ ἐὰν ἐργάσῃ εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ τοῦτο ξένους
verses.transliteration: Agapēte piston poieis ho ean ergasē eis tous adelphous kai touto xenous
verses.literal: Beloved you are faithful in what . . . you are doing for the brothers and especially since they are strangers to you

verses.original: οἳ ἐμαρτύρησάν σου τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐνώπιον ἐκκλησίας οὓς καλῶς ποιήσεις προπέμψας ἀξίως τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoi emartyrēsan sou tē agapē enōpion ekklēsias hous kalōs poiēseis propempsas axiōs tou Theou
verses.literal: They have testified to the church about your love You will do well to send them on their way . . . in a manner worthy of God

verses.original: ὑπὲρ γὰρ τοῦ Ὀνόματος ἐξῆλθον μηδὲν λαμβάνοντες ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνικῶν
verses.transliteration: hyper gar tou Onomatos exēlthon mēden lambanontes apo tōn ethnikōn
verses.literal: For they went out on behalf of the Name accepting nothing from the Gentiles

verses.original: ἡμεῖς οὖν ὀφείλομεν ὑπολαμβάνειν τοὺς τοιούτους ἵνα συνεργοὶ γινώμεθα τῇ ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: hēmeis oun opheilomen hypolambanein tous toioutous hina synergoi ginōmetha tē alētheia
verses.literal: Therefore we ought to support such men so that we may be fellow workers for the truth

verses.original: Ἔγραψά τι τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ἀλλ’ ὁ φιλοπρωτεύων αὐτῶν Διοτρεφὴς οὐκ ἐπιδέχεται ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Egrapsa ti tē ekklēsia all’ ho philoprōteuōn autōn Diotrephēs ouk epidechetai hēmas
verses.literal: I have written to the church about this but Diotrephes who loves to be first . . . will not accept our instruction

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο ἐὰν ἔλθω ὑπομνήσω αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιεῖ λόγοις πονηροῖς φλυαρῶν ἡμᾶς καὶ μὴ ἀρκούμενος ἐπὶ τούτοις οὔτε αὐτὸς ἐπιδέχεται τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ τοὺς βουλομένους κωλύει καὶ ἐκ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐκβάλλει
verses.transliteration: dia touto ean elthō hypomnēsō autou ta erga ha poiei logois ponērois phlyarōn hēmas kai mē arkoumenos epi toutois oute autos epidechetai tous adelphous kai tous boulomenous kōlyei kai ek tēs ekklēsias ekballei
verses.literal: So . . . if I come I will call attention to - his malicious slander . . . against us And unsatisfied with that he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so even putting them out of the church

verses.original: Ἀγαπητέ μὴ μιμοῦ τὸ κακὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ ἀγαθόν ὁ ἀγαθοποιῶν ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν ὁ κακοποιῶν οὐχ ἑώρακεν τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Agapēte mē mimou to kakon alla to agathon ho agathopoiōn ek tou Theou estin ho kakopoiōn ouch heōraken ton Theon
verses.literal: Beloved do not imitate what is evil but what is good The one who does good is of God the one who does evil has not seen God

verses.original: Δημητρίῳ μεμαρτύρηται ὑπὸ πάντων καὶ ὑπὸ αὐτῆς τῆς ἀληθείας καὶ ἡμεῖς δὲ μαρτυροῦμεν καὶ οἶδας ὅτι ἡ μαρτυρία ἡμῶν ἀληθής ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Dēmētriō memartyrētai hypo pantōn kai hypo autēs tēs alētheias kai hēmeis de martyroumen kai oidas hoti hē martyria hēmōn alēthēs estin
verses.literal: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone and from the truth itself We also testify for him and you know that our testimony is true

verses.original: Πολλὰ εἶχον γράψαι σοι ἀλλ’ οὐ θέλω διὰ μέλανος καὶ καλάμου σοι γράφειν
verses.transliteration: Polla eichon grapsai soi all’ ou thelō dia melanos kai kalamou soi graphein
verses.literal: I have many things to write to you but I would prefer not to do so . . . with pen and ink

verses.original: ἐλπίζω δὲ εὐθέως σε ἰδεῖν καὶ στόμα πρὸς στόμα λαλήσομεν Εἰρήνη σοι Ἀσπάζονταί σε οἱ φίλοι Ἀσπάζου τοὺς φίλους κατ’ ὄνομα
verses.transliteration: elpizō de eutheōs se idein kai stoma pros stoma lalēsomen Eirēnē soi Aspazontai se hoi philoi Aspazou tous philous kat’ onoma
verses.literal: Instead I hope to see you soon and speak with you face to face Peace to you The friends here send you greetings . . . Greet each of our friends there by name
